mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.accounts (id, account_type, role_id, username, password_hash, staff_member_id, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{accountType}, #{roleId}, #{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{staffMemberId}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(substr(username, char_length(#{base}) + 1) AS bigint)), 0) FROM public.accounts WHERE starts_with(username, #{base}) AND substr(username, char_length(#{base}) + 1) ~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$'
SELECT a.id, a.account_type, a.status, r.id, r.code, a.row_version FROM public.accounts a JOIN public.roles r ON r.id = a.role_id WHERE a.id = #{accountId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.accounts a JOIN public.roles r ON r.id = a.role_id JOIN public.staff_members s ON s.id = a.staff_member_id WHERE r.code = 'ADMINISTRATOR' AND r.active = true AND a.account_type = 'STAFF' AND a.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND a.id <> #{excludedAccountId}
